strongest_bounded_proposition: A later sixth-/early-seventh-century source supports sale of an Alodian slave girl, but not slavery in Alodia at exactly 500 CE.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not move later Alodian slave-sale evidence backward or infer continuous trade.
external_network_summary: Later regional slave-trade evidence is too late for anchor proof.
inference_extent: No inference beyond stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
